tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find purchasable product matches across merchants in a specified market. Use when the user wants to find or buy something: a need, a category, a budget, a gift idea, the best product of a kind, or the price of a named product. Returns normalized product entities with merchant count, price range and

tools.name: get_offers
tools.description: Return the full list of current merchant offers for one product in a market: merchant, price, currency, stock status, source timestamp, match tier, and a purchase link, cheapest first. Use when the user wants to see every merchant for one product — search_products already carries the cheapest one.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare two to five products side by side: brand, category, price range across merchants, merchant count, and the lowest current offer for each. Use when the user is choosing between named products.

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Find comparable products to a given product in the same market, optionally within a budget or with specific attribute changes. Use when the user asks for alternatives, cheaper equivalents, or "something like X but Y".

tools.name: recommend_product
tools.description: Rank a shortlist or a fresh search and return Edwin's recommended option, chosen on how well each product fits the stated need, its attributes and the stated budget. Affiliate commission does not affect ranking. Use when the user asks which product to buy or which option to pick. Use it for shopping
